text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open mixed to higher on Friday as investors probe uncharted territory one day after driving the Dow Industrials to their first ever close above the 7,000 mark.

"The futures are up slightly so I guess we'll have a mixed to higher opening," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "I don't think people will go nuts on the upside. Are they supposed to keep buying on top of a 500-point move just because the Dow topped 7,000? I don't think so."
